description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting within the WPEFramework. It includes abstract classes for warning events, warning reporting units, and control mechanisms for configuring warning categories, which are used to facilitate warning reporting and management in the system.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for a warning event, providing methods for obtaining category, serializing/deserializing data, converting to string, and identifying if it is a warning.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for a warning reporting unit, managing warning events and categories, including reporting, fetching category info, and managing category controls.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Nested interface within IWarningReportingUnit for controlling warning categories, supporting exclusion, configuration, and cloning operations.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Adds a category to the exclusion list.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a warning category with specific settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the warning reporting control instance.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with a specific identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a warning category, including whether it is default, enabled, excluded, and its configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the category list.
